marketing_description: The Schumacher® MAX XR® Series Battery Jump Starter (SL1672) delivers 1000 A peak current from a 12 V, 23.68 Ah lithium‑ion battery, automatically jumpstarting vehicles without manual intervention. It charges via a 12 V, 3 A USB input in 2–3 hours and operates from –4 °F to 122 °F, making it suitable for a range of commercial applications.
